name_en: Haba Zoni — New Year's mochi soup with dried habanori seaweed
summary_ja: 房州でとれる「はばのり」を干して刻み、焼いた餅にかけて汁を注ぐ千葉の正月雑煮。年明けにはばのりを食べると一年中「幅を利かせられる」と縁起を担ぐ地域の言い伝えがある。
summary_en: Dried habanori seaweed harvested along the Boso coast is crumbled over grilled mochi and broth for New Year's — eating it at the year's start is said to bring the local pun's promise of "carrying weight" (haba) all year.
source_title: はば雑煮 千葉県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Fuukashi — miso soup from steamed asari clams
summary_ja: あさりを蒸し、その蒸し汁に味噌を少し溶いた汁物。冷蔵設備のない時代、輸送のためにあさりを蒸かした汁を漁師が賄いとして飲んだのが始まりと伝わる、東京湾の漁師町らしい一椀。
summary_en: Asari clams are steamed, and their own steaming liquid is loosened with a little miso — said to trace to fishermen who steamed clams for transport before refrigeration existed and drank the leftover broth as a working meal, a bowl shaped by Tokyo Bay's fishing towns.
source_title: ふうかし 千葉県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Iwashi no Dango Jiru — sardine dumpling soup
summary_ja: 3枚におろしたイワシを味噌と長芋、卵と合わせてすり、大根や里芋の汁にだんごにして落とした冬の汁物。「海の米」と呼ばれるほど水揚げの多い九十九里のイワシを生かした家庭の定番料理と伝わる。
summary_en: Sardines are filleted, ground with miso, grated mountain yam, and egg, then dropped as dumplings into a broth of daikon and taro — a winter soup built on Kujukuri's sardine catch, once so plentiful it was called "rice of the sea."
source_title: いわしのだんご汁 千葉県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Toridose — chicken and rice porridge for New Year's and gatherings
summary_ja: 鶏肉とささがきごぼうをだしで煮て、味噌で味を付けたところに炊いたご飯を加えて仕上げる雑炊。正月や冠婚葬祭など人が集まるハレの日に食べられ、たたいた鶏の骨を団子に混ぜ込んで無駄なく使う工夫も伝わる。
summary_en: Chicken and shaved burdock simmer in broth seasoned with miso, then cooked rice is stirred in to finish — served at New Year's and other gatherings, with even the pounded chicken bones sometimes worked into dumplings so nothing goes to waste.
source_title: 鶏雑炊 千葉県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
